title: It's been 25 years since my jaw first dropped at 3DMark2001's Nature test but hoo boy, have 3D graphics changed since then
partialText: Dated and clunky, just like me.

title: 'GeForce 3 was such a transition for us': Nvidia's Jensen Huang looks back on 25 years of the classic graphics card
partialText: Feeling nostalgic?

partialText: Overwatch beat out an intergalactic RPG and a StarCraft MMO.

title: The first thing Arc Raiders' devs did during its extraction pivot was to reduce the speed of everything by 60%: 'All the craft that was in the game was kind of background noise'

title: Microsoft removes its 'This is an Xbox' marketing campaign and is slowly purging all mention of it
partialText: See you, space cowboy.

title: Major copper foil supplier raises prices by 12%, potentially ushering in a fresh wave of spikey prices for PCBs and plenty of PC components besides
partialText: Getting worse before it gets better.

title: Fortnite players revolt over V-Bucks changes as Epic devs appeal for calm: 'Paying the bills frees up our teams to continue driving stories and building stuff you love'
partialText: A Fortnite boycott is planned for March 19.

title: Over 48% of unreleased games have a Discord server, and I'm sure this is all fine and normal and I don't miss forums at all
partialText: How did we get here?

title: Journey composer Austin Wintory played an unreleased song from his canceled 'dream job of all time' during the Game Developers Choice Awards, just to drive home that the industry's doing great
partialText: Host Sam Maggs also named several canceled games that will never see the light of day.

title: Two laugh-out-loud moments in Zero Parades gave me hope that the Disco Elysium successor will still deliver flashes of brilliance
partialText: Two locked doors, two surprisingly funny and nuanced dialogue puzzles.

partialText: Long-in-the-works colony sim MMO Seed is shaping up into something that looks like EVE Online for RimWorld fans.

title: Shadowstone, the new game from Secret Door and Dreamhaven, kicks off a surprise public playtest at the Future Games Show Spring Showcase
partialText: The playtest is scheduled to run until Shadowstone launches into early access.

title: Blizzard vet Rob Pardo closed this year's GDC keynote by urging executives to cool it with the layoffs: 'The game team is more valuable than the game itself'
partialText: Somebody does have to make the next one, after all.

title: Path of Exile's new Mirage league might be the best chance you'll ever get at obtaining the rarest item in the game
partialText: This map's so nice I'll run it twice

partialText: "You know, you shouldn't trust us intelligent programmers."

title: Marathon got deadlier overnight, and some think yesterday's sound change is the culprit
partialText: "Can't shoot a single bullet without free kitted Assassins third-partying me in succession."

partialText: Kaplan says he prefers simple hero designs above all.

title: Dave the Diver DLC adds a little Stardew Valley time management and relationship building to the formula when In the Jungle releases in June
partialText: I'm scheduled for a fistfight with eels at noon.

title: Vin Diesel's character in Ark 2 was originally written as a nerd: 'Yeah, that ain't gonna work'
partialText: A bit of retconning took place when the Fast & Furious star joined Ark 2.

title: Bravely Default Flying Fairy HD Remaster, a hi-def update of the 2012 Silicon Studio classic, shadow-drops on Steam
partialText: A Switch 2 exclusive no more.

partialText: Participants ate up Dead Meat and other gen AI powered detective games.

title: Indie deckbuilder All Will Rise's dev joins No Games For Genocide boycott and plans to hand back funding it received from Microsoft
partialText: "We encourage others in the industry to join us and take a stand."

title: WoW's questing system was inspired by a playtest that didn't work out as planned, because the testers didn't play MMOs and had no idea what they were supposed to do: 'I ran out of quests right away!'

title: Subnautica 2 developer video reveals a 'brand new' base building system with some pretty fabulous windows
partialText: If you like building bases, you're probably going to like this.

title: Playing World of Warcraft with a controller might become my preferred playstyle thanks to this excellent gamepad-friendly addon that's letting me enjoy Azeroth from my couch
partialText: Please, try to contain your contempt.

partialText: This is giving me war flashbacks.

title: PNY GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB OC review
partialText: A solid pick.

title: One Australian gamer was denied a replacement for DRAM kit bought just two years prior and was only offered a refund of original price, four times less than its cost today
partialText: A miserable situation, all around.

partialText: New PEGI categories coming in June could see the age ratings for some games take a jump up.

title: Arc Raiders received 'substantial negative PvP sentiment' during testing, causing the devs to second-guess its big pivot before realising it was really frustration with weapons and matchmaking

partialText: Harrier Who Bois?

partialText: That's assuming the RAMpocalypse doesn't revise those estimates in the meantime.

partialText: "A lot of games would have been cancelled at this point."

partialText: It's times like these we'll long to forget.

title: This horror game where you're a conscious nuclear missile boasts 'one handed mouse only controls', leaving me with assumptions that proved incorrect when I had to saw my own limbs off
partialText: Brainshell's demo made me do awful things to myself.

title: Dispatch's character and concept artist was picked up on ArtStation 'as a last resort', a temporary solution 'to get us through the pitch phase', before defining the entire game's artstyle
partialText: Emergency call.

title: Bluepoint tech boss suggests Sony's scared of Valve, not Microsoft, and that's why it's pulling back from PC: 'It would be quite ironic if Valve ultimately ended up winning the console war'

title: Game dev union members marched at GDC to propose a 'Game Workers' Bill of Rights'
partialText: The UVW-CWA is envisioning a base standard set of working conditions for all game developers.

title: Asus thinks 'high-end brand value and high-end product mix' will help it weather the memory crisis alongside AI

title: Ever complained about Overwatch matchmaking? There's a chance Jeff Kaplan checked your account and all he has to say is: 'There's gotta be winners and there's gotta be losers'

title: One of Jeff Kaplan's 'regrets about Overwatch' was making it so team-orientated: 'I would downplay the team factor and try to put more focus on individual contribution'

title: Texture pop-in may be about to pop-out of existence thanks to even faster asset streaming ushered in by new Zstandard support in DirectStorage
partialText: Racing ahead.

partialText: And will it be limited to next-gen RDNA 5 GPUs?

title: Microsoft is paving more PC roads to Project Helix, releasing a Windows 11 Xbox Mode in April for laptops and desktops
partialText: This should make navigating Windows on controller easier.

title: WoW's Horde/Alliance split was 'really controversial', says Jeff Kaplan, to the point where it was only locked in 9-12 months before the game's launch
partialText: "He liked the fact you were instantly on a team."
